7834.text: You can learn from me in time... but not yet! Why don't you start out by talking to Sprite Jumpsprocket to my right here. You can check in with me after you've gotten your feet wet!

8122.text: You haven't lived until you've looked down on the world from the back of a wind rider.

26325.text: Be wary, for the plagued tendrils of the Lich King lurk close.
26325.text1: Be wary, for the plagued tendrils of the Lich King lurk close.

292961.text:
Professions are divided between two main categories: primary and secondary.

You are limited to a maximum of two primary professions at a time. You can abandon your skill in a primary profession at any time; however, the wealth of knowledge you gathered for it will be lost. If you choose to return to your original profession, you will need to train from the basics and seek out recipes you previously acquired to refamiliarize yourself with them.

Secondary professions do not have such a limit. These skills tend to err towards self-sufficiency with your basic survival needs. You are free to train any or all of these, but may find fewer opportunities to turn a profit.

299683.text: Hail and well met, traveler.$B$BI wish my arrival was met with good tidings but the realm of Dalaran is in need of aid from the kingdoms of the Alliance.

299703.text:
Unfortunately, the rumor of our plight is true. Disruptions to our leylines have unveiled a disturbance amongst the arcane forces of our city.

With Dalaran on the cusp of reopening its borders to our allies, we are in dire need of immediate solutions.

300665.text1: I'm in charge of Shen'dar Village operations, and there's a lot of things to keep track of around here. Between bandits, cultists, and other random incidents that pop up, keeping this village afloat is a lot of work.

301834.text: There won't be an explosion. The detonator I gave you was designed to fail.

301836.text: SI:7 will take things from here. The forge and warship you liberated from the Defias have strategic value and we are taking control of them.

301837.text1: You don't understand. That forge is poisoning the farms of Westfall! If it isn't destroyed, nothing will grow here for generations. You're risking a major famine!

301838.text: Thank you for your concern, elf, but this is now a Stormwind internal matter. Your help is no longer needed at this time.

304010.text: What do you need of me, child of Zephras?

304012.text1: What may I do for you, fellow windshaper?

327777.text1: <The great cat stretches its long, nimble legs as you approach, making no sound with the motion.>

327783.text:
<The tag on the mechanostrider reads:

H4z4rd Flashdasher 3X 4000. Now with new radiation sensors, and decontamination misters!>

327804.text: <Even through the visor on its helm, you can feel its gaze as it studies you.>
327804.text1:
<The wolf turns its head to regard you as you draw near. Even through the visor on its helm, you can feel its gaze as it studies you. It sniffs you gently, and after a moment lets out a low but not unfriendly growl in recognition. 

 
It stands up straighter, seemingly to show off the heavy armor adorning its body. The freshly polished metal gleams, even under a coat of Durotar dust kicked up by the hot winds. 

Something within you stirs and you sense that this wolf approves of your bravery and would be proud to bear you as its friend and rider.>

327805.text: <As you approach this wolf it shakes its great head; its armor glints gently against its ashen fur.>

327809.text: Oh aye, up in the back of the tavern there's a visitor from Aerie Peak who can probably help you with spiritual guidance or whatever it is that shamans do. Ingol? Ir... Ingrid! That was her name, Ingrid.
